description.value: The 515 Bar is a cozy craft cocktail and craft beer bar in the heart of Downtown Vancouver, named for the idea of unwinding after the 9-to-5. It specializes in hand-crafted, original cocktails alongside a curated food menu, served in an intimate space with eclectic music and whimsical lighting. The small, first-come-first-serve venue also offers full private event buyouts.
